clips.title: The story
paras: This campaign order from High Executor Darthalia directs Horde agents to strike deep into Azurelode Mine, a vital iron excavation south of Hillsbrad Fields. By eliminating Foreman Bonds and his crew, the Forsaken aim to sever iron shipments to Alliance armories and seize the tunnels for themselves.

Having seized the Hillsbrad Town Registry during earlier raids, High Executor Darthalia identified Azurelode Mine as a linchpin of human military endurance in the region. The mine operates just south of the contested fields, continuously extracting rich veins of iron ore to supply Alliance weaponsmiths and armories. Leaving it untouched would allow Southshore's forces to rearm and bolster their garrisons, rendering Tarren Mill's prior victories moot.

To completely break production, Darthalia targets both leadership and labor. Horde forces are ordered to eliminate Foreman Bonds, the human overseer running the excavation, along with a significant portion of his workforce. Striking into the dark shafts sends an unmistakable message to Southshore: neither their supply lines nor their isolated labor camps are beyond the Forsaken's reach.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The Hillsbrad Town Registry indicates that the Azureload Mine is under Alliance control. Furthermore, the mine is a prime source of iron ore for the Alliance armories.
Even though we've struck a decisive blow to the town of Hillsbrad, the Alliance still supports and protects the Azureload Mine fervently.
The mine lies due south of Hillsbrad. Go there and slay the foreman, a human by the name of Bonds. Kill his miners as well. That should send a clear message to the Alliance.

clips.title: Progress
paras: You were given direct orders to attack the Azureload Mine. Your reasons for loafing about Tarren Mill better be good or I will behead you for treason.

clips.title: Completion
paras: The Dark Lady will be pleased when she learns that she has a new mine from which she can arm her soldiers.
